records.title: WeHMiT-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models for Explainable Health Misinformation Detection in WeChat Article Titles
records.reason: WeHMiT-Bench evaluates Chinese health-misinformation detection by LLMs; its contribution is a benchmark and explanation-quality assessment.

records.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
records.reason: EADC is a compliance evaluation benchmark for legal/regulatory reasoning; it does not introduce an inference efficiency technique.

records.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
records.reason: ACLArena compares continual-learning and post-training methods for integrating agent capabilities; this is a training-focused evaluation.

records.title: LeaseGuard: Incumbent-Preserving Admission Control for Privileged LLM Agents
records.reason: LeaseGuard controls privileged agents’ access to shared resources to prevent incumbent preemption; it is resource safety/admission control, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
records.reason: ME-VLM is a multimodal embodied model and training pipeline for perception/planning; the abstract reports capability integration, not inference efficiency.
